parsed.reason: Description A says Bundle.locale now holds the normalised tag instead of the requested locale, with invalid locales raising ValueError. Description B says the per-key exists/get loop causes many Redis round trips (performance regression), plus a race between exists and get. These point at different defects: one is a change in returned locale value and error behavior, the other is a performance and race issue in the lookup loop.
